ideas.title: Paint Eggs for Pets
ideas.hook: Grab a blank egg, paint it any way you like, and it hatches a pet that looks like your design. Better paint jobs hatch rarer pets.
core_loop: Pick up a blank egg from the conveyor
Paint it with brushes, stickers and glitter
Hatch it into a pet that copies your colors
Sell spare pets for better paint and bigger eggs
ideas.twist: Other players vote on the eggs waiting on your shelf; top-voted eggs get a rarity boost before they hatch.
retention: Daily paint theme with bonus luck
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is up 2.13x (Backseat Rally 34.1K CCU, Kukirin Life 33.3K, Paint a Pancake 3.3K) and Paint × Eggs is the top open gap (7.03). Eggs games lead the chart (Break and Steal an Egg 147K, Fake an Egg 19.5K), and "___ for ___" titles are rising 3.38x.
ideas.differentiator: Egg games give you random pets; here you design the egg, so every pet you hatch is partly your own art.

ideas.title: Paint Your Way Out
ideas.hook: You are locked in a cartoon jail with a paint set. Paint a door, a tunnel or a ladder on the wall, and it turns real for ten seconds.
core_loop: Collect paint cans hidden around your cell block
Paint a door, hole or ladder on a wall
Run through before it fades and the guards notice
Escape each wing to unlock bigger brushes and new tricks
ideas.twist: Guards can paint too: they cover your art with wet paint traps, so you have to bait them into the wrong corridor first.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is up 2.13x and Paint × Prison is an open gap (4.99). Prison / police is rising 1.34x (Bike Universe 30.1K CCU, Steal and Escape Police! 4.2K), and interior maps are the fastest-rising map style at 2.11x (Sell Fries! 50.9K, Clone Baby Care 22.0K).
ideas.differentiator: Prison escapes are usually obbies or roleplay; here the paint brush is the only tool, and what you draw decides the route.

ideas.title: Sell Dino Eggs
ideas.hook: Run a prehistoric pet shop. Incubate dino eggs, raise the babies, and sell them to cavemen customers before they grow too big for the store.
core_loop: Buy eggs from the volcano supplier
Keep the incubators warm until they hatch
Feed and wash baby dinos for a better price
Sell to customers and expand the shop with new pens
ideas.twist: If you wait too long a dino outgrows its pen and starts eating stock, so you have to choose between selling fast and growing rare adults.
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop is up 2.06x (Sell Fries! 50.9K CCU, Fix My Phone! 15.1K) and Dinosaurs is the top rising theme at 2.1x (Ride a Dino 32.6K, Prehistoric Farm 3.4K). Sell × Dinosaurs is an open gap (5.9).
ideas.differentiator: Dino games are about riding or farming; this is a shop game where timing the sale is the whole skill.

ideas.title: Bonk Dinos for Eggs
ideas.hook: You are a caveman with a club. Bonk sleeping dinos to knock eggs loose, and every swing makes your club a little bigger.
core_loop: Swing your club to gain +1 strength
Bonk dinos in each valley to drop eggs
Carry eggs back to camp to hatch rare dinos
Spend eggs on new clubs and the next valley
ideas.twist: Bonk too hard and the dino wakes up and chases you back to camp, dropping eggs on the way.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is up 1.73x (Cat Battles 37.4K CCU, +1 Stone Skipping 22.6K, +1 Pickaxe Swing for Eggs 9.5K). Dinosaurs is up 2.1x (Ride a Dino 32.6K), and Hit × Dinosaurs is an open gap (4.96). "___ for ___" titles are the top formula at 3.38x.
ideas.differentiator: Swing-for-eggs games hit rocks or trees; here the egg source is a living dino that can fight back.

ideas.title: Scrap Robots for Parts
ideas.hook: A robot junkyard full of broken bots. Smash them apart for gears and chips, then bolt the parts onto your own robot that works your base.
core_loop: Smash junk robots with a hammer or drill
Collect gears, chips and rare cores
Build helper bots that mine for you
Unlock deeper junkyard zones with tougher robots
ideas.twist: Some scrapped robots reboot as hostile at night and raid your base, so you have to build defense bots too.
ideas.why_now: Break / mine / dig is the fastest-rising mechanic at 2.63x (Break and Steal an Egg 147K CCU, +1 Pickaxe Swing for Eggs 9.5K, Dig For Eggs 6.9K). Break × Robots / mechs is an open gap (4.62) while robot games are up 1.22x (RoChess! 4.5K, Kit PVP! 1.7K).
ideas.differentiator: Mining games break rocks; here every broken robot gives parts that come back as your own workers.

ideas.title: Sculpt Ice for Gems
ideas.hook: A frozen block lands on your table. Melt and carve it with a fire torch into a statue, then sell it before it drips away.
core_loop: Pick an ice block from the freezer
Carve it with a torch to match the order
Sell it at your stand for gems
Upgrade torches and unlock bigger, rarer ice
ideas.twist: The torch gets hotter as you upgrade, so the better your gear, the easier it is to melt a sculpture into a puddle.
retention: Daily statue order with bonus gems
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is up 2.13x and Paint × Ice / fire / elements is an open gap (4.27). Sell / run a shop is up 2.06x (Fix My Phone! 15.1K CCU), and satisfying close-up crafting is the newcomer look in shop games (Fix My Phone!, Make Ramen To Get Rich).
ideas.differentiator: Melt-the-ice games just clear it; here you shape it, and too much heat ruins the sale.

ideas.title: +1 Purse Power
ideas.hook: Strut down the runway and swing your purse. Every swing gives +1 power, and a strong enough swing launches rival models off the stage.
core_loop: Swing your purse for +1 power
Knock rivals off the runway for fame
Spend fame on heavier designer bags
Unlock bigger fashion-week stages
ideas.twist: Each bag has a style score, so a heavy ugly bag hits hard but drops your fame, while a cute light bag earns more per hit.
ideas.why_now: "+1 ___" titles are up 1.85x and +1 stat per action is up 1.73x (+1 Stone Skipping 22.6K CCU, +1 Venom Evolution 20.3K). Fashion / beauty is up 1.51x (Makeup Salon 13.2K, Facecard: Makeup Showdown 11.8K), and Hit × Fashion is an open gap (4.26).
ideas.differentiator: Fashion games judge your outfit; here the accessory is the weapon, and the runway is an arena.

ideas.title: Smash Drums for Fans
ideas.hook: Hit your drum kit and each beat sends out a shockwave. More hits mean louder waves that pull in fans and knock down walls to new stages.
core_loop: Hit drums to gain +1 volume
Shockwaves pull fans toward your stage
Spend fans on bigger kits
Blast through walls to bigger venues
ideas.twist: Hit on the beat and the wave doubles, so skilled players climb faster than pure grinders.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is up 1.73x (Cat Battles 37.4K CCU) and Music / dance is up 1.42x (Trending Emote Dance 8.1K, Piano Rhythm Tiles 4.7K, Aura Dance Battles 4.5K). Hit × Music and +1 × Music are both open gaps (3.61). "___ for ___" titles lead at 3.38x.
ideas.differentiator: Rhythm games score your timing; here timing powers an incremental climb, so it plays like a simulator with a beat.

ideas.title: Grow a Raptor Pack
ideas.hook: Grow raptors from eggs in your nest and set them along the path to stop egg thieves. Other players can send their raptors to raid your nest.
core_loop: Plant eggs in nest plots and grow raptors
Place raptors on lanes to stop thief waves
Earn eggs from waves to grow rarer dinos
Raid other players' nests for their eggs
ideas.twist: Raptors grow while they defend, so a baby placed early becomes your strongest guard by the last wave.
ideas.why_now: Tower defense is up 1.53x (Cameraman Tower Defense 35.6K CCU, Bunker vs Verity 12.5K) and Dinosaurs is up 2.1x (Ride a Dino 32.6K). Steal pairs with collecting and hatching for 214K-238K young CCU, and "Grow a ___" titles are rising 1.1x (Grow a Plant 8.1K).
ideas.differentiator: Tower defense units are bought from a shop; here you grow each one, and they keep growing on the lane.

ideas.title: Impound Cars for Cash
ideas.hook: Drive a tow truck around a realistic city, hook badly parked cars, and haul them to your impound lot. Owners pay to get them back, or you sell them.
core_loop: Patrol the city for parking tickets
Hook and tow cars to your lot
Charge owners or sell unclaimed cars
Upgrade trucks and expand the lot
ideas.twist: Players can be car owners too: they race to unlock their car before your tow truck pulls away.
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop is up 2.06x and Vehicles is up 1.29x (Bike Universe 30.1K CCU, Bike For Egg! 27.4K). Realistic art is the fastest-rising style at 2.02x (Kukirin Life 33.3K, Escooter Life 5.6K), and Vehicle Sim is up 1.44x.
ideas.differentiator: Driving games are about racing or roleplay; here the car is the product, and towing other players is the job.
